findings_qualitative.value: CO(2-1) map shows no detection in the central region, inside the UV cavity

evidence.quote: The CO map (which traces the cold phase of molecular gas) is clearly showing a region with no detection around the central region of the galaxy.

claims.hypothesis: Central star formation suppression in JO201 is due to AGN feedback rather than a stellar bar
claims.experiment: Combine UVIT, MUSE BPT, ALMA CO, red-continuum bar fit and SFH maps
claims.result: UV and CO cavities coincide with the AGN-dominated region; bar is longer than cavity and old; cavity appears in young-age SFR only
claims.finding: AGN feedback most likely suppressed central star formation within the last ~5e8 yr

evidence.quote: We conclude that the suppression of star formation observed in the central 8.6 kpc of JO201 is due to the effects of AGN feedback happening after infall of the galaxy into the cluster.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Dust extinction and stellar bar rejected as causes of central deficit

evidence.quote: Hence, the bar could not have suppressed star formation by totally sweeping the cavity of gas.

limitations_admitted.value: Cannot exclude significant star formation in the center, which is AGN dominated

evidence.quote: we cannot exclude the presence of even a significant level of star formation
